d: Bonza is a Dubai-based brand creating premium chocolate, pastries, gifts and floral arrangements, made in our own factory in Dubai Investments Park (DIP). We care about quality, creativity and a strong visual identity. We're building a small, talented team, and we're looking for an experienced, results-driven marketer to own our online growth.

You'll plan, launch and optimize Bonza's paid advertising across Meta, Google, Snapchat and TikTok, and support our social media presence. You'll turn ad spend into measurable growth. You'll also look after our website, keeping it fast, up to date and ready to convert the traffic you bring in.
q: 2+ years of hands-on experience running paid campaigns on Meta, Google, Snapchat and TikTok
Proven results, with real examples of campaigns you ran and their numbers
Comfortable using AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Meta Advantage+, Google Performance Max) to work faster and smarter
Strong command of Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Snapchat Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, GA4 and Google Tag Manager
Hands-on experience managing websites on both Shopify and WordPress
Basic HTML/CSS knowledge is a plus
Experience with the UAE / GCC market is a strong plus
Data-driven, organized and comfortable owning results
Fluent English; Arabic is a plus
Based in the UAE, or able to relocate
r: Plan, build and manage campaigns on Meta (Facebook & Instagram), Google (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube), Snapchat and TikTok
Manage budgets and bids, and optimize daily for ROAS, CPA and conversions
Run A/B tests on audiences, creatives, copy and landing pages
Set up and maintain tracking: Meta Pixel and Conversions API, Google Tag Manager, GA4, and the TikTok and Snap pixels
Brief the content team on ad creatives based on performance data
Report weekly and monthly on results, with clear insights and next steps
Support Bonza's social media accounts: scheduling, captions, community management and insights
Work with our content creator to turn top-performing content into ads
Maintain our websites on Shopify and WordPress : content, banners, products and landing pages
Handle routine maintenance: plugin and app updates, backups, broken links and basic speed and SEO checks
Build and improve landing pages for campaigns
Work with external developers when bigger technical changes are needed
x: Apply with your CV and 2–3 examples of campaigns you personally managed. Include the platform, budget range, goal and results. Anonymized screenshots from Ads Manager are welcome.
Your results must be your own. Please only share campaigns you personally ran. If you worked in a team or agency, tell us clearly what your role was.
Practical trial: shortlisted candidates will complete a short task (for example, a mini audit and campaign plan for Bonza)
UAE employment visa and medical insurance
Annual leave in line with UAE labour law
Real ownership of a growing brand's digital growth
A small team where your impact is seen and valued
